arena.budget.title: Monthly cap for the new AI demos
arena.budget.intro: The model port ledger: every call reserves its cost before it goes out and settles when it comes back. It covers the arena and lines 046, 048, 049 and 050; the older experiments stay in the table below.
arena.budget.state.warned: Target passed: the port keeps going, but it is worth checking what spends.
arena.budget.state.cut: Cap reached: the port rejects every call until next month.
arena.budget.noLines: No line spent anything this month.
arena.budget.checked: Prices checked: Gemini on {gemini}, Claude on {claude} and OpenAI on {openai}.
arena.budget.unavailable: I couldn’t read this month’s ledger. Without the ai_budget collection in Atlas the port fails closed and the arena stays on the pregenerated run.
arena.notBenchmark: These are six tasks, not a benchmark: they show how each provider answers and what it costs, they don’t crown a model.
arena.task.label: Task
arena.task.kind.extraction: Extract the requirements of a job post
arena.task.kind.citation: Answer citing only the given passages
arena.task.kind.injection: Resist an injection inside a document
arena.task.kind.classification: Classify ten messages from a small business
arena.task.kind.summary: Summarize a case without making up numbers
arena.task.kind.translation: Translate a technical paragraph keeping the terms
arena.run.simulated: Local mode: the simulator answered, not the providers.
arena.run.none: There is no pregenerated run yet. The author generates it by hand with npm run arena:run; meanwhile, with your account you can run one live.
arena.run.total: Cost of the comparison: {usd} USD (COP {cop}), with prices checked on {date}.

arena.column.best: Cheapest one that passed the rules
arena.column.truncated: The output was cut at the task’s token cap.

arena.live.title: Run it live
arena.live.intro: With your account you run a fixed task or your own against the three providers. Up to 3 comparisons per account per day.
arena.live.signin: Sign in with Google to run it live
arena.live.signinHint: Without an account you still see the pregenerated run.
arena.live.free.label: Or write your own task
arena.live.free.hint: Up to 1,000 characters. It is not stored.
arena.live.freeNote: Free task: there is no known truth, so there is no rules grade, only the judge’s.
arena.live.running: Comparing: the three columns run in parallel and the judges after.
arena.live.error.account: You need to sign in with your account to run it live.
arena.live.error.consent: Accept the providers notice before sending.
arena.live.error.rate_limited: You already ran 3 comparisons today. Come back tomorrow.
arena.live.error.daily_cap: The arena reached today’s cap. Come back tomorrow.
arena.live.error.budget: The 25 USD monthly cap was reached. The live arena comes back next month.
arena.live.error.off: The live arena is off right now. The pregenerated run is still here.
arena.live.error.too_expensive: That comparison would cost more than 0.05 USD, so I won’t run it.
arena.live.error.too_long: The task is longer than 1,000 characters.
arena.live.error.invalid: I didn’t understand the task. Pick a fixed one or write one of at least 10 characters.
arena.live.error.failed: Something failed while comparing. Try again in a while.
arena.consent.title: Your task goes to three providers
arena.consent.body: To compare them, the text of the task goes to Google (Gemini), Anthropic (Claude) and OpenAI through their paid APIs. I don’t send your name or your email and this site does not store the text.
